description: The mode now called --official only checks that the scale factor is a TPC scale point and refuses tuned-fallback (benchbox/cli/commands/run.py ~540-562, ~112-122); a missing seed only warns (run.py ~554). The throughput stream minimum is a flat 2 (benchbox/core/run_service.py ~29, core/schemas.py ~23) instead of the spec's per-scale-factor minimum. compliance_class "official" means only flag set and SF is a scale point (core/tpc_patterns.py ~48-57), independent of phases, query subset or streams. RF1/RF2 run in a maintenance phase after the throughput test, not concurrently (docs/benchmarks/tpc-h.md ~121-127). Owner decision 2026-10-08: enforce the full specification before the mode is renamed to "full-spec".
